'''Tott''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Republic Army]] who served in the [[Battle of Corellia]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the fighting in the [[Axial Park]] district, the Empire's [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rigby]] captured the [[Daoba Hotel]] with dozens of civilian hostages and began installing artillery atop the structure. Tott was unable to call in airstrikes on the hotel because of the civilians, but a Jedi and military effort free the hostages and cleared the hotel so that Tott could call down airstrikes and destroy the artillery.<ref name="Concierge" />
